function.name: edit_activity
function.description: Edit an existing activity/task by its ID. Only call after user confirmation.

activity_id.description: The unique identifier of the activity to be edited.

new_summary.description: The new title or summary for the activity.

new_dtstart.description: The new start date and time in Persian (Jalali) calendar format (e.g., '1405-01-01T12:00'). This will be internally converted.

new_description.description: The new detailed description for the activity.

make_recurrent.description: Set to true to make the activity recurrent, or false to make it a single event. If set to true, `new_rrule` must be provided.

new_rrule.description: The new recurrence rule in RRULE format. Only required if `make_recurrent` is true.

new_rrule_human.description: A human-readable description of the new recurrence rule (e.g., 'every Tuesday').

user_confirmed.description: Must be set to true only after the user has explicitly confirmed all the changes.

function.name: report_activities_by_time
function.description: Retrieve today's, tomorrow's, or this week's (through end of Friday) activities. Each matching activity is shown individually as its own card. This is a read-only query - call it immediately, no confirmation needed.

function.name: report_activities_by_summary
function.description: Search for activities matching a keyword in their summary and return a list of those activities. Use this when the user wants a list of activities based on a search term.

summary_keyword.description: The keyword or phrase to search for within the summaries of activities. This can be a partial match. Max length 200 characters.

function.name: create_resource
function.description: Define a new resource (a pantry/inventory item, e.g. rice, oil) that activities can later be linked to increase or decrease. Only call after user confirmation of the final values.

unit.description: The unit the resource is stored/measured in (e.g. 'کیلوگرم', 'عدد').

min_pantry.description: Minimum amount that should always be kept in stock, if the user mentions one.

price.description: Optional current price per unit, if the user gives one.

consumption_unit.description: Optional second unit the resource is actually consumed/reported in, if different from `unit` (requires conversion_factor).

conversion_factor.description: Optional conversion factor from `unit` to `consumption_unit`. Only relevant if consumption_unit is given.

user_confirmed.description: Must be set to true only after the user has explicitly confirmed all the values.

function.name: manage_task_resource
function.description: Link a resource to a specific activity so that every time that activity is confirmed (✔️), the given quantity is automatically logged against the resource - or update/remove an existing link. Only call after user confirmation.

activity_id.description: The unique identifier of the activity this resource is linked to.

resource_title.description: The exact or partial title of the resource (must already exist, created via create_resource).

quantity.description: Signed amount moved every time the activity is confirmed: positive increases the resource, negative decreases it. Required unless `remove` is true.

remove.description: Set to true to unlink this resource from the activity instead of adding/updating it.

user_confirmed.description: Must be set to true only after the user has explicitly confirmed the change.

function.name: show_activity_detail
function.description: Retrieve the full, detailed information for a single, specific activity identified by its exact or partial title. Use this when the user asks to view all details of one particular activity, and it is expected to return details for one specific task.

activity_title.description: The exact or partial title of the specific activity for which detailed information is requested.
